Name: Automate Spinning Wheel
Author: xinzhao2627
Description:
[b][size=3]Ever tired of endlessly playing the spinning wheel during the stardew valley fair? Well this mod just got you covered.
[/size]
[/b][size=3]Automate Spinning Wheel is a mod (from the name itself) that automatically do the task of making bets and playing the spinning wheel as long as you have enough star tokens to bet in.

[/size][b]How this mod works:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]It will automatically run only if you are near the person that manages the spinning wheel
[*]It will automatically run until you either reach the least or the most amount of star tokens possible
[*]It will NOT run if you go away from the spinning wheel / have 0 star tokens / have reached 9999 star token.
[*]It will only activate during the FALL 16 of every year.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility: [/b]This mod is compatible with every mods as far as I know.


You can check the code and releases at my public repository: [b]github.com/xinzhao2627/automatespinningwheel[/b]
